body:
📦 Modpack Description

This is a lightweight, performance-oriented modpack designed to deliver a smooth and stable gameplay experience in Minecraft, especially on low-end and mid-range systems. The primary goal of this pack is to maximize FPS, reduce lag spikes, and optimize overall game performance without altering the core vanilla feel.

Built using powerful optimization mods such as Sodium for enhanced rendering performance, Lithium for improved game logic efficiency, and Starlight for a completely reworked and faster lighting engine, this modpack ensures a noticeable boost in responsiveness and frame rates.

Additional performance improvements come from memory optimization, entity rendering tweaks, and faster loading times, making the game more efficient and stable during extended play sessions. The modpack also reduces unnecessary background processing and improves chunk loading, helping eliminate common stutters and lag issues.

Unlike heavy modpacks, this pack keeps things simple and clean — no unnecessary content mods, no gameplay changes, and no complex mechanics. Everything is focused purely on optimization, so you can enjoy the original Minecraft experience with significantly better performance.

This modpack is ideal for:

-Low-end PCs and laptops
-Players experiencing lag or FPS drops
-Those who want a smoother vanilla-like experience
-Long play sessions without performance degradation

Whether you're exploring vast worlds, building large structures, or just playing casually, this modpack provides a fast, stable, and optimized environment to enhance your gameplay.
